breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still explicitly instructs to model the shaft as a thin-walled closed circular tube and use the mean-area shear-flow relation (q = T/(2Am), τ = q/t) for the shear stress calculation. This is exactly the incorrect thin-walled approximation that the ground truth removes. The ground truth uses only the exact thick-walled torsion formula τ = T·(do/2)/J with J = π(do⁴ − di⁴)/32 for both the shear stress and angle of twist, with no thin-walled approximation involved.
